title: save_chart result
description: The structuredContent of the result of save_chart. The App reads it.

dashboard.description: The dashboard that has the saved panel.

url.description: The URL of the dashboard that a browser can open. Absent when the Source knows no such URL.

id.description: The ID of the panel in the dashboard.

type.description: The panel type of the saved panel. It can be a core panel of Grafana.

dropped.description: The path of each option of chart that the saved panel does not have. Can be empty.
